study_title: Friction-Budgeted Stabilization of RNTI-Level Containment in O-RAN

scope.unit: temporary RNTI lifecycle within an observable trace block

data.timestamp_status: empirically_inferred; authoritative unit unresolved at lock
data.cluster_wording: trace block, never true capture or campaign

partitions.probability_calibration: whole trace blocks in first part of 2022-10-26 UTC
partitions.controller_tune: whole trace blocks in second part of 2022-10-26 UTC
partitions.test_blindness_caveat: The full trace and preliminary go/no-go policy behavior were audited before lock, and risk diagnostics were computed on all partitions. Formal candidate thresholds and selection used controller_tune only. The evaluation partition is therefore a frozen chronological controller-policy outcome holdout, not a never-inspected test set.

risk_model.primary: regularized logistic regression plus Platt calibration
risk_model.sensitivity: depth-3 histogram gradient boosting with the same allowed KPI features

policy_selection.budget_atomic_tolerance: one maximum positive benign epoch divided by benign entity-time

primary_estimands.benign_friction: benign RNTI-time in RESTRICT or ISOLATE divided by benign RNTI-time
primary_estimands.malicious_allow: attack-labeled RNTI-time in ALLOW divided by attack-labeled RNTI-time
primary_estimands.malicious_not_isolated: attack-labeled RNTI-time in ALLOW or RESTRICT divided by attack-labeled RNTI-time
primary_estimands.policy_churn: ALLOW/RESTRICT/ISOLATE state changes per observed RNTI-minute
primary_estimands.episode_coverage: fraction of attack-labeled RNTI episodes reaching at least RESTRICT
primary_estimands.delay: onset-to-first-RESTRICT delay with misses censored and capped at 30 seconds

confirmatory_claim_sequence: report realized holdout friction and its 95% block-bootstrap interval; do not retune
test ALLOW-exposure difference proposed minus stateless against +0.02
test episode-coverage difference against -0.05 and capped-delay difference against +1 second
treat not-ISOLATED exposure and all per-attack comparisons as mandatory descriptive safeguards
